verdict.rationale: Cline can run fully local models via Ollama, LM Studio or Atomic Chat, supports bring-your-own provider keys, and claims you can self-host. That gives an indirect route to keeping code and prompts away from third parties that might train on them, and one community user confirms local models work well, though another reports Ollama support is weak with most models. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data policy or training opt-out control, documentation of how the Cline provider or ClinePass handles user data, and independent corroboration of the privacy posture.
